name: Far Watch Post
summary: Horde defenders hold Far Watch Post west of the Southfury River bridge, guarding the homeland's frontier. The outpost protects vital trade caravans from quilboar packs and Alliance incursions.

sections.title: Guardian of the Border
sections.body: Far Watch Post guards the western foot of the bridge from Durotar into the Barrens. You enter a vast, arid savannah, where this is the first sign of Horde authority. The settlement is spare but built for readiness, with an orcish watchtower, a burrow, and siege catapults aimed across the plains. South of the main road, peons tend riding wolves for messengers or reinforcements. The post keeps the supply road to Crossroads secure, screening travelers and turning back raids by roaming quilboar tribes and Alliance scouts.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Far Watch Post?
aliases: why is far watch post here
faq.answer: Far Watch Post guards the border between Durotar and the Barrens. Its defenders protect vital Horde supply caravans and keep quilboar tribes and Alliance trespassers from crossing the Southfury River into Durotar.
The Horde mans Far Watch Post as an active military camp. Orc grunts garrison the tower and maintain the siege engines, while peons tend the riding wolves.

faq.q: What threats does the outpost face?
faq.answer: Quilboar packs harass Far Watch Post from nearby scrubland, and Alliance forces may strike across the Barrens toward Orgrimmar.

angles.text: For a young Horde warrior leaving Durotar, Far Watch Post marks the last familiar ground before the rugged, dangerous heartland of Kalimdor.
Across the bridge from Durotar, Far Watch Post blocks Alliance scouts and saboteurs from easily approaching the orcish capital.
